Definition: Amasa, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Amasa = "burden"; 1) son of Ithra or Jether by Abigail the sister of David and general of the army of Absalom; 2) son of Hadlai and a prince of Ephraim in the reign of king Ahaz
